other.general_negative.title: Generic dislike with no specific problem
other.general_negative.description: Many reviews are short expressions of dislike, such as calling the app bad or the worst, without naming any concrete problem.

usability.ads.title: Too many interrupting ads on free tier
usability.ads.description: Free-tier listeners complain of frequent, long or repetitive ads that interrupt listening, sometimes several in a row.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Basic features locked behind Premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: Customers say core controls such as choosing songs, skipping, playing in order and seeking now require a Premium subscription.

billing.other.title: Frustration with paying for Premium or free limits
billing.other.description: Users object to needing to pay to listen, to free listening being cut short, and to the app being restricted to subscribers.

other.update_made_worse.title: Recent update made the app worse
other.update_made_worse.description: Customers say a recent update degraded the app overall and some uninstalled, without pointing to one specific defect.

playback.other.title: Assorted playback misbehaviour after updates
playback.other.description: Listeners report miscellaneous playback problems such as being unable to reverse or replay songs, unplayable podcasts and sessions dropping, mostly following an update.

access.login_failure.title: Unable to log in to the account
access.login_failure.description: Users cannot sign in through their usual method, including Facebook or phone number, and report login attempts failing outright.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Music stops or pauses unexpectedly
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: Playback cuts out or pauses on its own during listening, sometimes repeatedly, forcing users to restart the app to continue.

playback.not_playing.title: Songs fail to play at all
playback.not_playing.description: Tracks or the app refuse to start playing, including offline or on Wi-Fi, leaving users unable to listen to music they chose.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes, freezes or fails to open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: The app crashes, freezes on actions such as skipping, or will not open or load properly after updates.

usability.other.title: Miscellaneous confusing or awkward usability
usability.other.description: Users find various parts of the app unintuitive, buggy or restrictive, such as songs refusing to change and drag or seek not working.

usability.removed_features_update.title: Features removed or hidden by update
usability.removed_features_update.description: After an update, users find previously available functions such as the queue, scroll bar, mini player, or played-status markers gone or harder to use.

usability.shuffle_order.title: Forced shuffle, no way to pick songs
usability.shuffle_order.description: Users say the app plays songs out of order or randomly and cannot be turned off, so they cannot choose the specific song or order they want.

catalog.other.title: Songs and podcasts missing from catalog
catalog.other.description: Customers report that the library lacks many songs or podcasts, or that some tracks have been removed.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Difficulty managing queues and playlists
usability.queue_playlist.description: Users struggle to create a queue, view full playlists, or reorder and access their own playlists and library.

other.boycott_political.title: Boycott or political protest against Spotify
other.boycott_political.description: Some reviews call for a boycott or ban of Spotify, often citing its Swedish origin or political and religious grievances.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics missing, wrong or locked
catalog.lyrics.description: Lyrics fail to display for some songs or devices, or are shown only to Premium subscribers.

billing.monetization_greed.title: Perception that Spotify is money-focused
billing.monetization_greed.description: Customers feel the company is greedy, restricting free features to push Premium and prioritising revenue over users.

playback.bugs_glitches.title: General bugs and unstable behaviour
playback.bugs_glitches.description: Users describe the app as buggy and glitchy, with random restarts of playlists, unexplained songs running, and features misbehaving.

access.other.title: Other sign-in and account access problems
access.other.description: Customers report difficulty accessing their accounts, such as the app not opening or sign-in failing after switching devices or email.

downloads.other.title: Downloads limited or unreliable
downloads.other.description: Users find downloads locked behind Premium, storage location switching back to internal memory, and playlists dropping from downloads.

usability.ui_change.title: Disliked redesign and layout changes
usability.ui_change.description: Customers dislike the new home screen, layout, and visual design, with some saying they would cancel their subscription over it.

playback.lag_or_skips.title: Lag, buffering and slowness
playback.lag_or_skips.description: Users describe the app as slow, laggy or buffering, with songs skipping or glitching, prompting some to switch to other services.

billing.charges_refunds.title: Payment failures and unexpected charges
billing.charges_refunds.description: Customers report payments not activating Premium, charges they did not expect, difficulty changing payment methods, and trouble cancelling subscriptions.

usability.controls_widget.title: Player controls and widget not working
usability.controls_widget.description: Users find playback controls missing or unreliable, such as no previous-song button, a missing repeat option, or a widget that fails to show.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work properly
downloads.offline_mode.description: Downloaded music fails to play offline, and the offline mode gets stuck loading or stops working.

playback.connection_error.title: Connection errors during playback
playback.connection_error.description: The app wrongly reports being offline or fails to connect even with a strong signal or Wi-Fi, interrupting playback.

catalog.missing_content.title: Songs and artists missing or removed
catalog.missing_content.description: Users find that specific songs, artists, or podcasts are unavailable, missing, or removed from the catalogue.

playback.plays_wrong_song.title: Plays a different song than chosen
playback.plays_wrong_song.description: When users select a song or playlist, the app plays random or different tracks instead, forcing them to skip until they find the one they wanted.

usability.skip_limits.title: Skip limits block normal listening
usability.skip_limits.description: Free users hit caps on skipping and cannot replay or go back to previous songs, which restricts how they listen.

other.uninstalling_switching.title: Users uninstalling and switching to rivals
other.uninstalling_switching.description: Some reviewers say they uninstalled Spotify and are moving to competing apps such as YouTube Music, Deezer or SoundCloud.

billing.price.title: Premium seen as too expensive
billing.price.description: Customers feel the Premium subscription costs too much for the value, and some say they cannot afford it.

other.bugs_not_working.title: App simply does not work
other.bugs_not_working.description: Users say the app is broken or not working, with bugs in general and no specific defect identified.

downloads.cannot_download.title: Cannot download songs
downloads.cannot_download.description: Users are unable to download songs at all, including on free accounts, and some report it after paying for a plan.

catalog.search.title: Search fails to find wanted content
catalog.search.description: Searches return the wrong songs or no results, and podcasts or specific tracks do not appear when users look for them.

playback.audio_quality.title: Poor sound quality and volume
playback.audio_quality.description: Users find the audio compressed or weak, with volume dropping or no sound from songs playing on the app.

catalog.recommendations.title: Poor or repetitive recommendations
catalog.recommendations.description: Users find recommendations, radio and smart shuffle inaccurate, repetitive or unwanted, and cannot tell the algorithm what they dislike.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded music vanishes or re-downloads
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Previously downloaded songs and playlists disappear or must be downloaded again, sometimes after restarts or cache clearing.

billing.ads_for_paying_users.title: Ads still shown to Premium users
billing.ads_for_paying_users.description: Subscribers say they still hear ads, particularly on podcasts, even after paying for Premium.

access.logged_out.title: Unexpectedly logged out of account
access.logged_out.description: Users are signed out without action and then cannot log back in, sometimes losing their saved playlists.

billing.promotion_trial.title: Trial, student and family plan problems
billing.promotion_trial.description: Users struggle with trial periods, student or family plan eligibility, and being pushed to pricier individual plans.

other.premium_paywall.title: General objection to the Premium paywall
other.premium_paywall.description: Customers broadly resent Premium gating, calling the company corrupt and saying it has messed up the free experience.

usability.podcast_ui.title: Podcast and video experience problems
usability.podcast_ui.description: Users find podcast features lacking, such as a missing sleep timer, ads on podcasts, and video content that cannot be paused.

playback.battery_data_storage.title: Battery drain and data use
playback.battery_data_storage.description: Users report the app draining battery in the background and using excessive mobile data, even with a subscription.

catalog.ads.title: Ads and free-tier experience in catalog
catalog.ads.description: Complaints about the free service mix ads with catalog gaps, such as songs missing due to licensing and an unsatisfying radio.
catalog.ads.note: Mixes ad complaints, licensing-related missing songs, weak radio, and a wrapped-related grievance.

usability.autoplay_cant_stop.title: Autoplay cannot be stopped
usability.autoplay_cant_stop.description: Users say the app starts playing on its own, such as when connecting Bluetooth or opening, and that autoplay or repeat cannot be turned off.

support.other.title: Frustration with customer support access
support.other.description: Customers find it hard to reach a live person for help and feel the company is not responsive to their problems.

playback.device_bluetooth_car.title: Problems on Bluetooth, car and casting devices
playback.device_bluetooth_car.description: Playback breaks or drains devices when using Android Auto, Bluetooth, speakers, or watches, causing the app to fail through these connections.

catalog.liked_library.title: Liked songs and saved playlists lost
catalog.liked_library.description: Users find their liked songs or saved playlists missing or empty, and random unwanted songs get mixed into their playlists.

access.password_reset.title: Password and password-reset problems
access.password_reset.description: Users are told their password is wrong or cannot reset it, with no working forgot-password option available.

other.money_value.title: Not worth the money
other.money_value.description: Users say the app or subscription is not worth paying for and accuse the company of being money-hungry.

usability.navigation.title: Confusing navigation and menus
usability.navigation.description: Users find the app hard to navigate, with menus, settings and icons confusing and songs not directly reachable.

access.phone_email_verification.title: Phone or email verification failures
access.phone_email_verification.description: Sign-in fails because the app rejects valid phone numbers or OTP codes, or says the number is wrong.

access.signup.title: Unable to create an account
access.signup.description: New users cannot sign up for an account or Premium, with errors appearing during registration.

access.account_hacked_or_lost.title: Account hacked or lost
access.account_hacked_or_lost.description: Users report their accounts were hacked, taken over or lost, with loss of data and slow or unhelpful recovery.

access.connection_offline.title: Access blocked by offline or connection errors
access.connection_offline.description: Users cannot sign in or access their account because the app shows them as offline or logs them out when offline mode is set.

other.ads.title: General complaints about ads
other.ads.description: Reviewers express broad dislike of the number of ads and say the app shows too many commercials and gathers data for advertisers.

catalog.wrapped.title: Spotify Wrapped not appearing
catalog.wrapped.description: Users report that their annual Spotify Wrapped summary does not show up, and some say it is missing in their region.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Premium not activating after payment
billing.subscription_activation.description: Users pay for Premium but the app stays in free mode or cannot complete the upgrade, so the features never unlock.

catalog.content_controversy.title: Objections to content and host controversies
catalog.content_controversy.description: Some users want certain hosts removed or object to specific content appearing on the home screen, citing controversial figures.

support.unresponsive.title: Support does not respond
support.unresponsive.description: Users say emails go unanswered and that chat or bot support never reaches a human to resolve their problem.

support.unhelpful.title: Support replies do not resolve problems
support.unhelpful.description: Users say support answers are useless, scripted or dismissive, and that their issues stay unsolved.
